own.reason: Fix wraps delete_check in transaction.atomic with a select_for_update re-read: the bug is a concurrent ping failing an in-progress delete. Findings 0-4 (TOTP double-accept, duplicate flips, stale last_ping/n_pings write-backs, shared Ping.n) and 5 (notify overwriting a delivery-failure disable) are all ping/flip/notify lost updates in other code; none touches deletion. No later selected fix, so no open list.

Fix puts Check.ping's Check save and Ping creation in one transaction (S3 upload outside): the bug is sendalerts seeing the updated Check before the Ping row exists, a visibility gap. Finding 1 (stale in-flight ping undoes a pause) touches Check.ping but is a different mechanism (lost status update vs missing-row visibility), confirmed over pause/status state, not over Ping creation. Finding 0 is a billing race. Open fix 6375b0aac4 (ping-during-delete) matches neither finding.

open.reason: Adopted from label-matcher L (curator initially none): fix bug is a Check.ping-save vs sendalerts race on Check state (sendalerts sees the updated Check before the Ping row exists). Finding 1 (ping save clobbers the sendalerts status flip) is the same code region with the same counterpart (ping's Check save vs sendalerts status) but a different mechanism (stale write-back clobber vs non-atomic publication) and effect — partial per the same-region rule.

own.reason: Fix re-checks email availability before finalizing a change-email verification: a TOCTOU on User.email in hc.accounts.views.check_token. All 7 findings are ping/flip/config-edit/billing lost updates; none touches the change-email flow. Open fixes 311f7064dc (Ping-creation visibility) and 6375b0aac4 (ping-during-delete) match no finding: the closest, finding 1 (ping save clobbers the sendalerts status flip) and finding 2 (dropped start event), are status/last_start lost updates, not the Ping-row visibility gap or the delete race.

Fix defers Celery .delay calls in create_order with transaction.on_commit: the bug is task-before-commit (worker runs before the order row commits). Findings are a site-cache KeyError race (0), download lost-counts/cap-bypass (1, 2, model-level) and a checkout shipping-method invalidation race (3); none touches order-confirmation task timing. Open fixes 4e1d404170 (fulfillment on_commit), 6eb11d58ad (attribute lock order) and d9c6325792 (adyen lock order) match no finding.

Fix locks the checkout before the payment in adyen webhook handlers (same order as checkoutComplete): the bug is a payment/checkout lock-order deadlock. Findings are a site-cache KeyError race (0), download over-serve (1) and late-binding deferred stock callbacks (2); none touches adyen webhooks or checkout/payment lock order. No later selected fix, so no open list.

Fix wraps AttributeValueUpdate.post_save_action in atomic with order_by(pk) select_for_update: the bug is inconsistent Product-row lock order across concurrent updates. Findings are a site-cache KeyError race (0), late-binding variant-stock webhooks (1) and download lost increments (2); none touches attribute mutations or product lock order. Open fix d9c6325792 (adyen lock order) matches no finding.

Fix defers order_fulfilled notification with transaction.on_commit (and makes it atomic): the bug is notify-before-commit in create_fulfillments. Findings are download over-serve/lost-counts (0, 3), order-discount lost totals (1) and a site-cache KeyError (2, model-level, free-threaded-only); none touches fulfillment notification timing. Open fixes 6eb11d58ad (attribute lock order) and d9c6325792 (adyen lock order) match no finding.

Fix hoists geolite2.reader() to module level in get_country_by_ip: the bug is one thread closing the shared reader while another uses it. Findings are concurrent ProductImage order sharing (0) and Order history tail disagreeing with status (1); neither touches geolocation. Open fixes 1763643eab, 4e1d404170, 6eb11d58ad and d9c6325792 (on_commit timing, lock orders) match no finding.
